record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly set learning rate to 5e-4 and existing input dropout to 0.2, retaining hidden width 128, one GRU layer and history length 128. Stronger dropout may reduce dependence on individual history items, while the smaller learning rate may stabilize updates under that added noise. Preserve Adam, feature definitions, embedding tying and normalization, readout and loss; keep seed 42, the 200-epoch cap and 200 batches per epoch.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, jointly increase input dropout to 0.2 and reduce learning rate to 5e-4. Stronger regularization may reduce reliance on individual history items, while smaller updates may stabilize training under added dropout noise. Retain width 128, one GRU layer, history length 128, Adam, the existing loss and one checkpoint per category. Existing metadata and predictor loading remain compatible; dropout is disabled during inference.
